current.text: Coach Ime Udoka has blamed Sengun's defense for years and tends to limit his minutes. Other bigs sometimes play over him.
Houston has more guard depth now, so his minutes could drop from about 33 to 31 or 32.
Fred VanVleet is back as the projected starting point guard. The Rockets also added Marcus Smart and Bogdan Bogdanovic to the guard rotation.
With VanVleet back, his assists will likely fall to 5 to 5.5 per game. Last season was already his best shot-blocking year, so blocks will not make up for the lost assists.
He is the projected starting center next to VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr.
Lloyd ranks him 24 to 30 in category leagues and a little higher in points leagues. He calls the ADPs reasonable.
Josh thinks he is worth about 30 USD in an auction. He went for 29 USD in a mock auction.
With our March 28 end date, the Rockets play 3, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21, which is 10 games in total.
That is a weak fantasy playoff schedule.
The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs this season.
Houston is predicted to win 54 games.

durable.text: He has an unusual line for a center: over six assists plus steals and blocks. His assists are far above his position.
He is a two-time All-Star who can put up about 20 points, 10 rebounds and 5 assists.
He is a poor free throw shooter, and on his volume that clearly hurts a team's FT%.
His turnovers are high for the league and for his position.
He makes very few threes, and his three-point shot will probably never come around.
He is not a big shot blocker for a center.
He gives good FG% and decent steals.
His weaknesses are defense, finishing at the rim, overall efficiency, too many low-percentage mid-range shots, and complaining to officials.
Last season he missed time with back tightness and then an ankle injury. He wore down in the middle of the season after playing EuroBasket.
He is worth more in points leagues than in category leagues.

note: Yahoo and ESPN average costs are both about 33 USD and our league paid 36 USD last season. Josh puts him near 30 USD and Lloyd ranks him 24 to 30 in category leagues, so do not chase him above about 30 USD. His FT% (z -2.2) and turnovers (z -1.7) drag him down, but he fits punt FT% and punt TO builds well because his assists from the center spot (z +2.3 vs position), rebounds and points stay strong. Early in the season, check whether Udoka keeps him near 33 minutes or cuts him to 31 to 32, and whether his assists hold up with VanVleet back. Also plan around Houston's weak 10-game playoff schedule.
